query:
SELECT
          t.user_id AS user_id,
          t.revoked_at AS revoked_at,
          EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM refresh_tokens f
            WHERE f.user_id = t.user_id
              AND f.revoked_at IS NULL
              AND f.expires_at > now()
          ) AS "family_live!"
        FROM refresh_tokens t
        WHERE t.token_hash = $1
